# gate reads this file from the trusted refs/heads/main checkout, never
# from a pull request head.

# The file sits under /.github/scripts/ in CODEOWNERS, so an edit to it is
# a sensitive-path change and needs an approval from a login listed below.
# To add or remove a member, edit this file in a pull request.
#
# Drift is fail-closed: a team member missing from this list has their
# approval rejected until their login lands here.
